evidence: failure.log: 'src/refunds.py 14 14 0%' and 'ERROR: Coverage failure: total of 22% is less than fail-under=80%'
failure.log: both test_orders tests pass ('OK'); the exit code 2 comes from the coverage check
repo/tests/ has only test_orders.py; nothing imports refunds
Local check: with the proposed tests/test_refunds.py, coverage goes to 100% (src/refunds.py 14/14) and the job passes
patch:
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_refunds.py
@@ -0,0 +1,20 @@
+import sys, unittest
+sys.path.insert(0, "src")
+from refunds import refundable, reason
+class TestRefunds(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_outside_window_not_refundable(self):
+        self.assertEqual(refundable(50, 31), 0.0)
+    def test_custom_policy_window(self):
+        self.assertEqual(refundable(50, 31, policy_days=60), 50)
+    def test_non_positive_total(self):
+        self.assertEqual(refundable(0, 1), 0.0)
+        self.assertEqual(refundable(-10, 1), 0.0)
+    def test_no_fee_at_or_below_100(self):
+        self.assertEqual(refundable(100, 10), 100)
+    def test_fee_above_100(self):
+        self.assertEqual(refundable(200, 10), 190.0)
+    def test_amount_below_one_not_refundable(self):
+        self.assertEqual(refundable(0.5, 1), 0.0)
+    def test_reason(self):
+        self.assertEqual(reason(31), "outside window")
+        self.assertEqual(reason(30), "eligible")
